results.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
results.overview: Unable to keep secrets and losing the people closest to her, Tanya turns to a therapist who offers an unconventional treatment involving a knife and a black candle.

results.title: Udumbanchola Vision
results.overview: When album designer Midhun takes over a struggling local TV channel, he uncovers a deadly rivalry behind its downfall. Using secrets and manipulation, he rises to power, but his ambition quickly turns to greed. Just as he dominates the industry, a dangerous international threat emerges.

results.title: Projection
results.overview: A woman and a man meet in a motel room to slow dance. She’s hurting and he’s very aware of that.

results.title: Жужа
results.overview: Zhuzha's world consists of observation, careful scrutiny, and study, but not interaction. Zhuzha prefers silence to words, and because of this, few understand her, and therefore, she's not very interesting. Unlike her younger sister, violinist Anka, whose world consists of endless rehearsals, school bustle, and preparation for impending university entrance exams. They are the closest people to each other, but everything changes when Zhuzha meets Yura, a deaf boy for whom she becomes a conduit, a way to connect with sounds inaccessible to him, and, without realizing it, she suddenly transforms from a background extra into the protagonist of her own story.

results.title: Texas Two-Step
results.overview: When a woman returns to Texas to help save her aunt's struggling country music bar, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy and rekindles her lost passion for dancing.
